parts.t: Dollarton is one of North Vancouver's best-kept secrets — a quiet, waterfront community along the shores of Indian Arm offering a lifestyle of unparalleled natural beauty. With boat launches, beachfront properties, and a true escape-from-the-city feel, it's one of the most unique addresses on the North Shore.
